en:
This is an official announcement from the
Ultimate Academy.

It is now 10 p.m. For one o' you bastards,
this might be your last <CLT=cltSTRONG>nighttime<CLT=cltNORMAL> ever.

Don't do something violent to start the killing
game. You can make it one more night.
Weeeee... *hic!*
...Oh! I get it now! I totally get it!

It's crystal clear to me now!
I understand everything!
...See, look at your face.

The way your eyes are angled...
The way your face is floating...
That's a crazy face.
...Hehehehehe! Hahahahahaha!

Monokid seems really out of it. Is this what
happens when you drink too much honey?
Bedtime, ursine!
<CLT=cltMIND>Last nighttime ever, huh...?

<CLT=cltMIND>No, it won't be our last nighttime ever...
Just our last night in this horrible place.

<CLT=cltMIND>Tomorrow night...I'm getting out of this place
with everyone else.

<CLT=cltMIND>Yeah... We promised we would all be friends
once we got out.

I hear kids these days don't even say
"<CLT=cltSTRONG>thank you<CLT=cltNORMAL>" anymore.

I blame the parents! They haven't properly taught
them the true meaning of "<CLT=cltSTRONG>thank you<CLT=cltNORMAL>"!

It's very important to express gratitude to
someone who has done something for you.

It will make that person feel happy, and they
might do something special for you later.

In other words, "<CLT=cltSTRONG>thank you<CLT=cltNORMAL>" isn't just about
conveying gratitude...

...it also conveys the expectation of a favor
in the future.

So the more you say "<CLT=cltSTRONG>thank you<CLT=cltNORMAL>," the more
you can use the people around you.

So always say "<CLT=cltSTRONG>thank you<CLT=cltNORMAL>" to people, and make
them do lots of stuff for your benefit!
Rise and shine, ursine!

This is an official announcement from the
Ultimate Academy. Wake up, bastards. It's 8 a.m.

Oooh, today's the day the time limit expires.
My heart is pounding with excitement.

Don't worry! Even if you end up in hell, at least you
can be proud that you didn't do the killing game!
You're just assumin' they're gonna go to hell?

This ■ is in ■ and you 16 are the ▲ who ▲ ●
to leave ■ and come ● as the ▲■ humans!

Hey, Monokid... Why don't we go over there and
drink some more honey, okay?
So long, bear-well!

<CLT=cltMIND>The time limit was set to expire tonight...but
weirdly enough, I was looking forward to it.
<CLT=cltMIND>Even then...I barely slept the whole night.

<CLT=cltMIND>I slapped my cheeks and leaped out
of bed.

Alright! First, I need to go to Shuichi's room!
We're gonna catch that mastermind together!
Yes
No
Are you unsure of something?
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Would you like to leave?

<CLT=cltMIND>It's a monitor for communicating with us...
But there's nothing displayed right now.
